[SWS_PHM_00230] Keep Global Supervision Status kEXPIRED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status is kEXPIRED,
• the GlobalSupervision corresponds to Operating System, Execution Man-
agement or State Management and the measured Expired Supervision Time is
less than the configured expiredSupervisionTolerance OR
• the GlobalSupervision DOES NOT correspond to Operating System, Execu-
tion Management or State Management and the Elementary Supervision
Status of at least one corresponding Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kEXPIRED,
then the Platform Health Management shall keep the Global Supervision
Status kEXPIRED.
